tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Concrete encasement to columns of CHP structure in phased manner at YTPS

itemList.description: Providing and laying in cement concrete for all basement & surface level works, return walls, retaining walls, sunken floors etc. The granite /trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, usage charges of machinery, formwork, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M20 Design mix using 20mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates.
